summary: Iteration 3 (cover image + photo reorder + photo scale/focal) fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 31/31 pytest tests pass (added 12 new tests for cover upload/get/delete + PATCH scale/focal + PDF export regressions + cross-user 404). Frontend: full editor flow via Playwright confirms cover upload/remove buttons swap correctly, photo-tray drag reorders the sequence AND persists via save (PATCH 200), PhotoEditor sliders (scale/focal_x/focal_y) mutate the img transform + objectPosition live, reset restores defaults, and all previously working editor features (add-text, font/color/size, prev/next, export PDF) still work with no regressions.

issues: Cosmetic: after drag-reorder, tray thumbnails and flipbook images look nearly identical because the seed images are solid colors — real photos should still work but the visual cue for order relies solely on the small numeric badge. Consider a subtle border-highlight or drop shadow on hover.
Editor 'Ajouter texte' still overflows the item's bounding box at large font sizes (carried over from iteration 2). Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: PhotoTray.jsx uses `slot-{index}` as dnd-kit item ids so if photo_ids contain duplicates the drag still works — good.
AlbumEditor.reorderPhotoSequence preserves each page's slot count and only remaps photo_id — clean and matches the tray's flat sequence model.
Backend PDF export applies scale + focal offset with clipPath — verified 200 application/pdf under scale=1.5 focal=(0.2,0.3).

server.py still uses synchronous `requests` for Emergent Object Storage calls inside async endpoints (put_object/get_object). Under load this will block the event loop; not a bug for now but worth flagging. Consider httpx or a thread pool.
server.py is ~860 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; recommend splitting into modules (auth, albums, storage, pdf, ai) in a future iteration.
coverImageUrl helper appends `&v={version}` for cache busting — good, and matches AlbumEditor's coverVersion bump after upload/remove.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added TestCoverImageAndPhotoEditing class with 12 tests + raised status-poll timeout to 30s with retry loop)
seed_data_creation: One user + one A4 portrait album 'Ma Voyage Test' with 3 JPGs (food/landscape/portrait). AI processing completed in ~6-8s. Album deleted at end of backend suite.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PhotoTray uses PointerSensor with activationConstraint distance:6. To drag reliably via Playwright, use manual mouse.down() → small nudge (>6px) → move-to-target with steps → mouse.up(). page.drag_to() may not trigger dnd-kit activation. To simulate slider changes on <input type='range'> in React, use the native property setter (Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set) and dispatch 'input' + 'change' events — otherwise React ignores el.value=... assignments. PhotoEditor sliders only appear after clicking a [data-testid^='page-photo-'] element (need to flipNext to reach content pages first).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration.
